data.description:
Operator-reported freezes when multiple browser surfaces are open; corroborated fleet-wide by Sentry and a local macOS CPU-resource diagnostic.

EVIDENCE
- Sentry C11-1 (https://stage-11-kl.sentry.io/issues/C11-1): AppHang >=8s in DisplayList.ViewRenderer, 135 events / 8 users since 2026-05-04, still firing on 0.51.0+108. Main thread stuck in NSHostingView.layout -> ViewGraph.renderDisplayList with deep recursive _layoutSubtreeWithOldSize chains. ~20 sibling AppHang groups share the same main-thread-layout signature.
- Local CPU diag /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/c11_2026-06-11-135049_Hyperion.cpu_resource.diag: 56% CPU for 160s, heaviest stacks = continuous NSHostingView.beginTransaction -> GraphHost.flushTransactions -> repeated sizeThatFits passes every runloop turn. Zero WebKit frames - churn is in c11 chrome, not the webviews.

MECHANISM (verified in source)
- BrowserPanelView.swift:589-590 - onPreferenceChange(BrowserAddressBarHeightPreferenceKey) writes addressBarHeight @State with no equality guard.
- That state feeds paneTopChromeHeight into WebViewRepresentable (BrowserPanelView.swift:1325); updateNSView + host.onGeometryChanged call BrowserWindowPortalRegistry.updatePaneTopChromeHeight + 4 more portal updates synchronously on every geometry change (BrowserPanelView.swift:6282+, 6315+, 6357+). Portal updates can move frames -> geometry preference re-fires -> oscillation. N browsers = N interfering loops.
- Terminal portals already have the fix browser portals lack: deferred/batched geometry sync (scheduledExternalGeometrySynchronize + dirty-ID sets, TerminalWindowPortal.swift:1017-1034) and epsilon guards (TerminalWindowPortal.swift:1695). Browser side only has a downstream epsilon check (BrowserWindowPortal.swift:2907) which stops the portal write but not the upstream SwiftUI re-render.

FIX SHAPE
1. Port the terminal portals' deferred+batched geometry sync pattern to browser portals.
2. Equality-guard the addressBarHeight preference write (epsilon, like TerminalWindowPortal.swift:1695).
3. Validate with C11_PORTAL_DEBUG=1: open 3-4 browser panes, confirm geom.external/sync.result spam disappears in /tmp/c11-portal.log; confirm idle CPU with 4 browser panes open.

Repro/validation notes will be appended from the instrumented repro pass (tag: browser-freeze).
data.title: Browser portals: fix SwiftUI layout feedback loop (multi-browser freeze)

data.body:
INSTRUMENTED REPRO PASS (2026-06-12, tag: browser-freeze, C11_PORTAL_DEBUG=1)

Setup: tagged Debug build, 4 browser panes (example.com), driven via automation socket. Evidence archived at notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/ (portal log + the 2026-06-11 CPU diag).

RESULTS
1. NEGATIVE for a self-sustaining geometry feedback loop under synthetic conditions. Steady state with 4 idle browsers: 0 portal log lines / 30s, ~5-6% CPU. 40 socket-driven pane resizes + focus switches: 15 portal lines, all frames converge, zero events after churn stops. The portal sync path dedupes correctly in this configuration.
2. The unguarded addressBarHeight write (BrowserPanelView.swift:589) and synchronous portal updates in updateNSView remain real scaling costs confirmed in source, but they do NOT self-oscillate with light pages, no DevTools, default chrome. Whatever sustains the fleet's C11-1 hangs needs real workload conditions: heavy/dynamic pages, DevTools attached (deep slot view trees feed the per-event hit-test scan, see C11-133), many total surfaces, and/or memory pressure.
3. Supporting the memory-pressure angle: the sampled C11-1 event (e52679c6db26497d84f81ed77dd482b8) shows free_memory ~570MB of 64GB at hang time. N WKWebViews = N WebContent processes at 100s of MB each. BrowserPanelView force-remounts the panel subtree when WebKit replaces a terminated WebContent process - under memory pressure with several browsers this means repeated structural SwiftUI rebuilds (portal detach/orphan/rebind storms) on top of paging. Observed portal-log signature of a remount storm: bind.before with fresh anchorIds, transient duplicate entries (entryCount briefly 6 with 4 browsers), orphan.hide anchor=deallocated, detach.

GUIDANCE FOR IMPLEMENTER
- Do the C11-134 breadcrumbs FIRST if sequencing allows: fleet data on workspace shape at hang time will say whether browser count actually correlates, cheaper than guessing.
- Profile under real conditions: heavy pages (not example.com), DevTools attached, 10+ total surfaces. Simulating WebContent process termination (kill the WebContent pid of a pane) while watching /tmp/c11-portal.log + a time-profiler trace is the highest-signal experiment for the remount-storm path.
- The fix-shape items in the description stand (deferred/batched sync, equality guards) as hardening, but validate against a reproduced hang, not just the synthetic setup above.

CORRECTION to the repro notes above (important for implementation):

1. C11_PORTAL_DEBUG / /tmp/c11-portal.log instruments ONLY the terminal portal layer (portalLog lives in TerminalWindowPortal.swift). BrowserWindowPortal logs through separate "browser.portal.*" debugLog lines, NOT the portal log. The detach/orphan/rebind storm signature in the archived log was the TERMINAL portal reacting to operator pane rearrangement in the tagged instance - not browser webview replacement as the previous comment implied. The memory-pressure/WebContent-termination hypothesis stands (BrowserPanelView's remount-on-process-termination comment is real), but it has NOT been observed in a log yet.

2. Implication: there is an observability gap - browser portal bind/detach/orphan events are invisible to C11_PORTAL_DEBUG. Consider extending portalLog coverage (or an equivalent gated logger) to BrowserWindowPortal as part of this ticket; without it, validating the fix against browser-portal churn is guesswork.

3. The WebContent-kill experiment recommended above should therefore be observed via the browser.portal.* debug lines (DEBUG build event log) or the new logging you add, not /tmp/c11-portal.log.

Implementation started in worktree c11-132-browser-portal-sync (branch fix/c11-132-browser-portal-geometry-sync off a3f8855fd). Survey: browser portal already has the scheduling skeleton; missing dirty-ID batching (deferred tick syncs ALL webviews), settled-layout deferral, and any portalLog observability (browser portal emits ZERO portal-log events today — the repro log's bind/sync lines are all terminal-portal). Plan appended to plan file.

BEFORE capture done against the still-running triage build (tag browser-freeze, base a3f8855fd, C11_PORTAL_DEBUG=1): fresh workspace + 4 example.com browser panes via socket; log settled at 211 lines; killed WebContent pid 40229; WebKit replaced it (pid 46354) and the page recovered — and the portal log emitted ZERO lines for the entire remount, because the browser portal has no portalLog instrumentation at base. The pane-creation churn window (75 lines, all terminal-portal events) + idle CPU samples (~6.5%) archived at notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/c11-132-before-webcontent-kill.log. After-build (tag c11-132) compiling now; c11-logic: 907 pass / 1 unrelated flaky (StdinHandlerFormattingTests.testDeliverReportsClosedWhenSurfaceNotFound, passes in isolation) / 3 skipped.

PR open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/237 (branch fix/c11-132-browser-portal-geometry-sync, 2 commits off a3f8855fd). Validation evidence committed in-branch at notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/: before/after WebContent-kill portal logs, churn-settle analysis, 4-pane screenshot. Summary: dirty-ID batching + settled-layout deferral + addressBarHeight epsilon guard + browser.* portal-log observability. After-build: remount visible and batched (deferredSync.run count=1), full quiescence after churn, ~2% idle CPU with 4 browser panes. Caveat honored: framed as hardening + observability, not a confirmed C11-1 fix (synthetic loop did not reproduce with light pages).

E2E validation evidence (tagged build c11-132, C11_PORTAL_DEBUG=1, 4 browser panes): (1) WebContent-kill remount observed via the NEW browser.* portal-log events — detach -> 3 bind passes -> deferredSync.run count=1 (only the affected webview re-synced), 16 lines/32ms, then quiescent; at base the same experiment produced 0 log lines (browser portal previously invisible to C11_PORTAL_DEBUG — per Triage-1's correction comment, which this PR's instrumentation closes). (2) Churn settle: 10 workspace switches / 859 rebind lines -> zero trailing events. (3) Idle CPU ~2.0% with 4 browser panes. Artifacts committed in-branch: notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/c11-132-{before,after}-webcontent-kill.log + c11-132-after-4panes.png. Acknowledging Triage-1's correction: my before-capture independently confirmed the attribution gap (0 browser-portal lines at base) and PR #237 ships the portalLog extension the correction asked for. REBASE NOTE: branch rebased onto main after C11-134 (PR #236) landed — one conflict in BrowserWindowPortal.swift hideOrphanEntriesIfNeeded (both sides moved anchorWindowDesc out of #if DEBUG; resolved keeping C11-134's sentryBreadcrumb + this branch's portalLog side by side). c11-logic re-run post-rebase: 907/911 + 1 load-sensitive benchmark flake (CommandPaletteSearchEngineTests.testSwitcherSearchBenchmarkBeatsLegacyPipeline) that passes in isolation. PR #237 MERGEABLE again.

MERGED to main: PR #237 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/237, merge commit on 2026-06-12, all CI green). Delivered: (1) dirty-ID-set batching for the browser portal's deferred geometry sync, mirroring TerminalWindowPortal.runDeferredHostedSync — deferred tick now re-syncs only marked entries instead of all webviews; (2) settled-layout double-defer with trigger labels on scheduleExternalGeometrySynchronize; (3) 0.5pt epsilon guard on the addressBarHeight onPreferenceChange write in BrowserPanelView; (4) env-gated browser.* portalLog events closing the observability gap Triage-1's correction flagged (browser portal previously invisible to C11_PORTAL_DEBUG). Validation: before/after WebContent-kill experiment (base: remount invisible, 0 lines; fixed: visible, batched, deferredSync.run count=1, settles in 32ms), 10-workspace-switch churn settles to zero trailing events, ~2% idle CPU with 4 browser panes, c11-logic green. Rebased over C11-134 (one conflict in hideOrphanEntriesIfNeeded, resolved keeping breadcrumb + portalLog). Evidence in notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/. Honest framing stands: this is hardening + observability, not a confirmed C11-1 fix — the synthetic loop did not reproduce with light pages. Remaining threads for future work: C11-135 (orphan-terminal bleed during DevTools attach, filed during validation).
